The four races

Etherlords has four races, each drawing on its own colour of ether. A race's spells share a style of play.

RaceEtherStyle
Chaotsred Ether of Flamedirect damage and aggressive creatures
Vitalsgreen Ether of Naturestrong creatures, growth and healing
Kinetsblue Ether of Airflyers, tricks and control over the opponent's spells
Synthetsblack Ether of the Machinedestruction, weakening and draining the opponent

Etherlords II adds pale (colourless) spells and Diamanda, the ancient creation of heroes' magic, the subject of its last campaign. Pale spells fit any spellbook.

Races and spellbooks

In a duel, a hero's spellbook must match the hero's race (pale spells are always allowed in Etherlords II). In the campaigns a hero can collect spells of any colour.

See Spells for the kinds of spells each race uses.
